name: Rome Ciampino Airport (G.B. Pastine)

curfew.v: private and commercial flights only between 06:00 and 23:00 local; outside these hours PPRs are issued only for emergency, ambulance and state flights
curfew.quote: Excluding emergency/ambulance/state operations, PPRs can be released only within the airport opening time for private and commercial flights, that is between 06.00LT and 23.00LT

ppr.v: every arriving general-aviation aircraft needs a PPR from the airport operator, issued in advance according to stand availability and requested by the carrier or handler
ppr.quote: Incoming aircraft of the general aviation are subject to the issuance of a permit, ... issued in advance on the basis on the availability of the stands by the Managing Company (Prior Permission Request - PPR).

max_aircraft.v: general-aviation PPRs are capped at 61 movements a day (medical, emergency and rescue flights excluded), under Ministerial Decree 345/2018
max_aircraft.quote: In compliance with the provisions of Ministerial Decree 345/2018, ... PPR may be issued up to a maximum of 61 daily movements

handling.v: the General Aviation Terminal and its services are open 07:00 to 23:30; GA handlers must be ENAC-certified for Ciampino
handling.quote: The General Aviation Terminal and of all its relative activities and services are open from 07:00AM to 11:30PM.

slots.v: a coordinated airport (slot allocation by Assoclearance)
slots.quote: ha classificato come aeroporti coordinati gli scali di: ... Roma Ciampino

notes: ENAV eAIP needs an ENAV account and could not be opened; ADR's passenger GA services page blocks automated reading. Facts come from ADR's Ciampino Airport Regulations (English translation, rev. 2, updated 16/10/2025; the Italian text prevails). The 61-movement cap is a daily cap on GA PPRs, filed under max_aircraft for want of a better key. Night limits at Ciampino have been the subject of court cases; re-check before quoting to clients. Re-researched 2026-10-29: 29 Oct 2026: No new verified facts. The Ciampino Airport Regulations (rev. 2, 16 Oct 2025) say refuelling is in the Airport Manual ('Refuelling See Airport Manual'); the noise/APU sections listed in the contents could not be read (reader cut off the text). The operator is stated there: 'prepared for the Airport of Ciampino by Aeroporti di Roma SpA, as the Airport Managing Company'. Terminal hours given (departures 03:00-23:00, arrivals 06:00-24:00) are terminal, not aerodrome, hours. ADR's airport manual (PA Generale rev. 24, 2 Sep 2024) and GA services page block automated readers. 'CIA' in the regulations glossary is the airport's abbreviation, not stated as its IATA code.
